characters.summary: Emil Blonsky, enhanced with a variation of the Super Soldier Serum and injected with Bruce Banner's blood, transforms into a monstrous, highly durable brute who relies on overwhelming physical strength, bone spurs, and relentless aggression.

mechanisms: Superhuman durability capable of withstanding high-caliber military fire

weaknesses: Prone to blind fury and arrogance
Vulnerable to sustained, overwhelming blunt trauma from heavier hitters like the Hulk
limitations: Intelligence and combat tactics can degrade into mindless savagery when enraged

sources.supports: Abilities, origin, and combat style of Abomination in the MCU.

feats.claim: Fought the Hulk to a standstill in Harlem before being overpowered.
Easily overpowered a squad of elite soldiers and military vehicles.

notableResults.note: Defeated and choked unconscious by the Hulk after a prolonged brawl in Harlem.

conditional.dependsOn: Exposure to Bruce Banner's blood combined with the Super Soldier Serum

campaignTags.claim: Emil Blonsky transforms into a towering monster well over eight feet tall.
Possesses an accelerated healing factor derived from mutant/gamma biology.

unknowns: Exact limits of his durability against cosmic or mystical attacks are untested.

characters.summary: Adam Warlock is a genetically engineered Sovereign being gifted with immense cosmic energy projection, natural flight, and formidable physical strength, though initially hampered by his childlike naivety.
weaknesses: Emotionally immature and easily manipulated due to premature removal from his cocoon
limitations: Prone to obeying commands from his creator or superiors due to his youth

sources.supports: Abilities, cosmic powers, and appearances in Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3.

feats.claim: Flew through space and engaged the Guardians of the Galaxy on Knowhere.

notableResults.note: Sustained severe injuries during the clash on Knowhere before later changing allegiances.

campaignTags.claim: Adam Warlock flies naturally using his cosmic physiology.

unknowns: The full potential of his cocoon regeneration and adult powers remains largely unexplored.

characters.summary: A hypothetical or corrupted alternate state of Adam Warlock driven by absolute malice and maximized dark cosmic energy.
limitations: Tied to the same physiological boundaries as base Adam Warlock
characters.formDifferences: Represents a corrupted psychological and energetic variant of Adam Warlock with intensified hostile intent.

sources.supports: Base physiology for Adam Warlock adapted for corrupted form.

unknowns: This specific alternate persona has no direct standalone appearances in the MCU continuity outside of theoretical extrapolation.

characters.summary: Agatha Harkness is an ancient, highly experienced witch who drains the magical life force of other practitioners and uses telekinesis, energy absorption, and dark spellcasting.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to having her own magic stolen or neutralized by superior spellcasters like the Scarlet Witch
limitations: Requires verbal incantations or physical gestures for many advanced spells

sources.supports: Magical abilities, history, and spells used in WandaVision.

feats.claim: Controlled the actions of an entire town (Westview) using subtle magical manipulation.
Drained the magical energy of her own coven in 1693.

notableResults.note: Defeated when Wanda Maximoff reclaimed her true power as the Scarlet Witch and stripped Agatha of her magic.

campaignTags.claim: Practices ancient witchcraft and dark spells.
Casts complex spells and energy projections.

unknowns: Full extent of her powers post-WandaVision.

characters.summary: Ajak is the wise leader of the Eternals, possessing cosmic energy manipulation, advanced healing capabilities, and direct communication with the Celestial Arishem.
weaknesses: Bound by strict devotion to the Celestial Prime directives
limitations: Cannot alter the grand design of the Celestials on her own authority without severe consequence

sources.supports: Abilities, role as leader of the Eternals, and healing powers.

feats.claim: Healed severe physical injuries on humans effortlessly.

notableResults.note: Betrayed and left to be consumed by Deviants by Ikaris.

campaignTags.claim: Heals wounds and injuries using cosmic energy.

unknowns: Limits of her healing capabilities against cosmic-level destruction.

characters.summary: America Chavez is a young traveler from another dimension who can punch star-shaped portals through the multiverse, paired with superhuman durability and strength.

mechanisms: Superhuman durability capable of withstanding intense multiversal forces

weaknesses: Powers trigger uncontrollably under extreme fear or emotional stress
limitations: Inability to control portal destination reliably without emotional clarity

sources.supports: Portal creation, durability, and origin in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness.

feats.claim: Transported herself and Doctor Strange across numerous universes during escape from demons.
feats.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022)

notableResults.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022)
notableResults.note: Targeted across universes for her power before turning the tables by making Wanda confront her grief.

campaignTags.claim: Opens star-shaped portals to alternate universes.

unknowns: Full offensive combat repertoire outside of portals and basic physical defense.

characters.summary: Scott Lang uses Pym Particles via his suit to shrink to insect size or grow to giant proportions while maintaining proportional strength, accompanied by an army of controlled ants.
weaknesses: Vulnerable if separated from Pym Particles or helmet regulator
limitations: Prolonged exposure to giant form places severe strain on human biology

sources.supports: Suit capabilities, Pym Particle usage, and combat feats.

feats.claim: Grew to Giant-Man size to distract opposing heroes at Leipzig/Halle Airport.
Infiltrated complex computer hardware at microscopic scale.

notableResults.note: Overwhelmed and brought down while in Giant-Man form by collaborative effort.

campaignTags.claim: Shrinks down to microscopic size or grows to giant scale using Pym Particles.
Uses advanced Pym tech helmet and suit.

unknowns: Exact upper limit of physical mass in giant form.

characters.summary: Attuma is a formidable Atlantean warrior and general of Talokan, wielding immense underwater strength, durability, and a vibranium spear in combat.
weaknesses: Requires water or hydration to maintain peak fighting efficiency over extended periods
limitations: Reduced mobility on dry land compared to water

sources.supports: Atlantean strength, vibranium spear, and combat role in Black Panther: Wakanda Forever.

feats.claim: Fought Okoye to a standstill and defeated her in hand-to-hand combat during the bridge battle.

notableResults.note: Defeated Okoye during the initial raid by tossing her off the bridge.

campaignTags.claim: Atlantean warrior adapted to deep-sea combat.
Swims at high speeds in aquatic environments.

unknowns: Full extent of Talokanil technology outside of vibranium spears and water-breathing masks.

characters.summary: May Parker is Peter Parker's guardian, operating primarily as a supportive civilian and compassionate community worker rather than a combatant.
weaknesses: Normal human vulnerabilities with no superhuman defenses
limitations: Lacks any supernatural powers, combat training, or specialized gear

sources.supports: Background, role, and civilian status in the MCU Spider-Man films.

feats.claim: Evacuated civilians and offered shelter during crises.

unknowns: No documented combat wins against named opponents.

characters.summary: Ayo is a top-ranking Dora Milaje warrior who fights with elite martial arts mastery, vibranium spear tactics, and unwavering discipline.
weaknesses: Physically human with standard biological limits
limitations: Relies entirely on physical training and standard-issue Wakandan gear

sources.supports: Dora Milaje training, vibranium weapons, and combat feats.

feats.claim: Disarmed Bucky Barnes by swiftly removing his vibranium arm's safety protocol.
feats.citation: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier (2021)

notableResults.citation: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier (2021)
notableResults.note: Quickly humiliated Bucky in close combat by disabling his cybernetic arm.

campaignTags.claim: Wields advanced vibranium weaponry and armor.

unknowns: Performance against super-powered cosmic adversaries without backup.
